events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that iconic rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 55 Years On
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: Apple launched the first iPod
events.blurb: The original Apple iPod was unveiled on this day in 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It completely changed how we listened to music. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No', the very first Bond film.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007 and over six decades of iconic cinema. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. So much incredible music on one record – what's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we said goodbye to a true legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year, and his extraordinary voice.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61 Years
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed boundaries. A masterpiece from start to finish.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. He would have been 86 this year.
